OUR SERVICES

End-to-End Robotics & AI Engineering

Complete cycle robotics development — from real-world data collection to Isaac Sim digital twins and neural edge deployment.

Data Collection & Dataset Engineering

01.1

Synthetic Data Generation

High-fidelity procedural sensor synthesis, domain randomization, and simulated lidar/depth dataset compilation for robust vision models.

01.2

Human Egocentric Data Collection

First-person vision capture, dexterous hand tracking, and multi-modal sensory dataset collection for imitation learning pipelines.

01.3

Teleoperation Data Collection

Haptic feedback tele-manipulation, real-time kinematic logging, and expert demonstration recording across diverse physical tasks.

AI Model Training & Deployment

02.1

Reinforcement Learning for Quadrupeds

Sim-to-real locomotion policies, dynamic terrain adaptation, and disturbance recovery.

02.2

Vision-Language-Action (VLA) Models

Zero-shot robotic control, spatial grounding, and natural language command execution.

02.3

World Action Models (WAM)

Predictive physics modeling, next-frame world state forecasting, and trajectory planning.

02.4

Model Deployment & Optimization

TensorRT compilation, edge NPU acceleration, ONNX runtime quantization, and low latency.

Robotics Simulation & Digital Twins

03.1

NVIDIA Isaac Sim Integration

GPU-accelerated photorealistic sensor rendering, PhysX 5 dynamics, and benchmark environments.
